title: Extract projector and subspace distance analysis
status_detail: Created by the human instruction `create these as tasks`. This records a proposed subspace-analysis task only; it does not choose among projector, principal-angle, or operator metrics.
objective: Define explicit projector and spectral-subspace distance analyses for repeated periodic and topological comparisons without conflating them with ordinary matrix differences.
authorized_scope: After separate explicit activation, inventory actual projector-distance consumers and establish one explicit state-space, rank, metric, and unit contract.
Keep projector distance, principal-angle information, basis-vector distance, and gauge-dependent matrix distance distinct.
Require a human decision if multiple materially different metrics remain defensible for the public contract.
completion_criteria: The selected distance definition has explicit domain, codomain, dimensions, rank prerequisites, range, and numerical tolerance behavior.
At least two matching production consumers use the public analysis and independent verifiers remain independent.
Tests distinguish equal subspaces with different bases from genuinely different subspaces.
exclusions: Do not call a small projector distance scientific validation or physical alignment.
Do not silently choose a metric for convenience when the owning scientific contract is ambiguous.
No protected execution, release, publication, or automatic successor activation is authorized.
